title: Escape from the Forbidden Grounds
next_chapter_hook: Chen Nian's eyes flickered with a complex light, her voice dropping low: 'Brother, the emperor imprisoned me not just for the dragon vein... He wants to use the dragon vein spirit within me to perform a ritual that can rewrite heavenly fate!'

text.content: That voice pierced through the abyss like a faint ray of light, precisely striking Chen Ji's soul. 'Ji... brother...' The garbled syllables echoed in his mind, carrying pain, longing, and a flicker of hope. Chen Ji's pupils sharply contracted—that voice was Chen Nian! His sister he had searched for countless years! The Tianji Record fragment quivered intensely in his Mental Sea, and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a startled cry: 'The call of the Heavenly Fate Key... She can sense your presence! Quickly, she's in the deepest part of the Forbidden Grounds, suppressed by the imperial dragon vein!' Chen Ji clenched his fists until his knuckles turned white, yet his face had already regained its customary composure. Perfect timing.

dialogue.content: (Low voice) Chen Nian... wait for brother.

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, channeling the Tianji Record fragment. A pale golden light gathered at his fingertips as temporal-spatial power swirled around him. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul urgently said: 'Use the Tianji Record to peer into events within the next three hours, find the gaps in guard rotations! But be careful—each divination costs five Heavenly Fate points, your current reserves... cannot afford much spending.' Chen Ji did not hesitate. Was Heavenly Fate more important, or his sister? This question needed no answer in his heart. The fragment unfolded, and the next three hours unfurled before him like a carousel—the Forbidden Grounds' layout, patrol rhythms, the sealing formation's eye of the chamber holding Chen Nian... all laid bare before his eyes.

Three breaths later, Chen Ji opened his eyes, a faint smile curling at his lips. Found it. A tunnel entrance on the western side of the Forbidden Grounds, with a brief window of unguarded moments every half-hour—precisely enough time for infiltration. And the sealing formation's eye would enter a weakness period at the third watch of the Yin hour, lasting a quarter hour. As precise as a scalpel—this was his preferred style. Chen Ji's form flickered, becoming a barely perceptible shadow, merging into the night. The Tianji Record's aura was suppressed to its extreme, not even stirring the air. The imperial city's intricate formation array spread like a spider's web, yet not a single point could detect his presence—as if he simply did not exist within this world's rules.

The tunnel was deep and dark, torchlight casting swaying shadows on the walls. Chen Ji moved through like a specter, each step precisely landing outside the guards' field of vision. The Tianji Record flickered again—ahead at the corner, two guards were changing shifts, gossiping about imperial city rumors. 'I heard that imprisoned lady is beautiful as a celestial maiden, what a pity...' 'Hush! Speak less! That's a key prisoner ordered by the emperor himself—discussing her is courting death!' Chen Ji's footsteps did not falter, yet cold killing intent welled in his heart. Under the emperor's nose, treating lives like grass was merely dinner table chatter. He memorized their faces—not now, but eventually he would settle the score.

dialogue.content: (Inner monologue) The forbidden chamber, third watch of the Yin hour... faster.

text.content: Third watch of the Yin hour. Before the chamber, the sealing formation's light indeed dimmed, like a dying candle. Chen Ji raised his hand, Heavenly Secrets power forming a slender silver needle, precisely piercing into the formation's core node. Hum—the seal rippled, then silently shattered. No one was alerted, no alarm triggered. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul revealed a satisfied smile within the Mental Sea: 'Beautiful. The Tianji Record's temporal-spatial power is the nemesis of all formations—you did even cleaner than I anticipated.' The stone door slowly opened, and Chen Ji stepped inside. In the dim chamber, a frail figure curled in the corner, iron chains wrapped around her delicate wrists, burning horrifying wounds into the flesh.

dialogue.content: (Weakly) Who... have you come to extract the dragon vein power again? I won't let you succeed...

text.content: Chen Ji's heart clenched painfully. The little girl who used to run after him calling 'brother' with her double bun hairstyle, now gaunt and skeletal, her eyes filled with wariness and despair. He stepped forward slowly, voice low yet carrying undeniable gentleness. 'Niannian, it's brother. Chen Ji.' The figure trembled violently, slowly raising her head. A pale yet still beautiful face came into view—the features still bore traces of childhood, but with far too much haggardness that did not belong at this age. Chen Nian's eyes instantly reddened, her lips trembling yet producing no sound. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, grasping the cold chains with a firm grip, channeling Heavenly Secrets power through his palm—clank clank clank—the locks all shattered.

dialogue.content: (Trembling, throwing herself into his embrace) Brother... it's really you... I'm not dreaming, am I...

text.content: The moment Chen Nian threw herself into his embrace, Chen Ji felt a burning heat in his chest. How many years? Counting from the day the Chen family was destroyed, it had been a full seventeen years. He thought he had forgotten how to shed tears, yet now his eyes burned with acrid pain. He said nothing, only tightening his arms, protectively embracing his sister's emaciated form. The Tianji Record fragment quivered gently, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul rarely fell silent—this moment rendered any words superfluous. After a moment, Chen Ji released her, reaching up to gently stroke her hair, voice hoarse yet steady: 'Not a dream. Brother came to save you. From now on, no one will ever harm you again.' Chen Nian nodded vigorously, tears streaming down uncontrollably, but in the next moment remembered something urgent, her expression dramatically changing.

Chen Ji sensed her unusual state, eyes narrowing slightly: 'What's wrong?' Chen Nian lowered her voice urgently: 'Brother, they... the emperor imprisoned me not just for the dragon vein... He wants to use the dragon vein spirit within me to perform a ritual that can rewrite heavenly fate!' Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. Chen Nian continued: 'I overheard their conversations in the Forbidden Grounds... That ritual requires the 'Heavenly Fate Key' as a vessel to communicate between the imperial dragon vein and the Heavenly Will. Once successful, the emperor can rise above the rules of heaven and become a true... Eternal Emperor!' Eternal Emperor? Above heaven? This ambition... was a hundred times more insane than Chen Ji had anticipated. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly spoke in his Mental Sea: 'This is precisely what the Eye of Heaven wants! It needs a mortal puppet to break the balance of the three realms!'

dialogue.content: (Cold gaze) Interesting... the emperor wants to become heaven's master, yet doesn't know he's merely being used as a weapon by heaven.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian tightly gripped Chen Ji's sleeve, eyes filled with trust and dependence. And the Tianji Record showed that the Yin hour was nearly exhausted—the guard window period was about to end. Escape immediately, or take this opportunity to give the emperor a 'surprise'?

choices.description: My sister's safety outweighs everything. Since we already know the emperor's purpose, the priority is to get Chen Nian out of danger. We can plan further later.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to cause trouble for the emperor
choices.visible_reward: Ensure Chen Nian safely exits the Forbidden Grounds
choices.risk_hint: Pursuers may soon discover the anomaly
choices.process_label: carry Chen Nian, use tianji movement

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate for a split second, scooping Chen Nian up into his arms. The Tianji Step Technique erupted fully, his entire form transforming into flowing light rushing toward the chamber's exit. Behind them, the final drum of the Yin hour had just sounded, guards' footsteps beginning to approach—but already too late. When the first patrol squad rounded the corner, the chamber was already empty, only broken chains and a shattered sealing formation eye remained, silently testifying to what had just transpired.

dialogue.content: (Clutching his neck tightly) Brother, we really escaped...

choices.description: Since we've come all this way, why not leave some 'souvenirs' in the chamber, letting the emperor know someone visited, and，顺便给皇朝的龙脉根基动点手脚。
choices.visible_cost: Might alert more guards, increasing the difficulty of escape
choices.visible_reward: The foundation of the imperial dynasty's dragon vein is damaged, the emperor's conspiracy postponed
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian's body is weak, the spacetime rift consumed enormous energy

text.content: A cold curve formed at the corner of Chen Ji's lips. He formed a seal with one hand, and the power of Heavenly Secrets transformed into countless tiny runes, sinking into the four walls and floor of the secret chamber. These runes, like dormant vipers, would quietly activate in seven days, causing irreversible chaos in the imperial dynasty's dragon vein operation. And before that, the ceremony the emperor had meticulously prepared... would become a joke. Chen Nian watched her brother calmly布置 the 'death trap', her eyes flickering with complex emotions—reverence, heartache, and an indefinable pride. This was her brother, that Chen Ji whom everyone mocked as waste.

dialogue.content: (Softly) Brother... you're even more formidable than the legends say.

text.content: Whatever choice he made, Chen Ji knew clearly—the real battle had just begun. He carried Chen Nian穿梭 through the imperial city's underground passages, and behind them, the guards'发现了异常的骚动与呼喊隐约传来。但这些都不重要了。时空之力在指尖凝聚，一道细小的裂隙quietly撕开——那是通往皇城之外的捷径，也是陈机为今日准备的退路之一。裂隙的另一端，是皇城十里外的一片荒山。当陈机抱着陈念踏出裂隙时，清冷的夜风扑面而来，带着山野间特有的草木气息。身后，皇城的喧嚣恍如隔世。

dialogue.content: (Gazing toward the imperial city, voice trembling) Brother, we... are we really free?

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer, only reaching out to tidy her disheveled hair. Under the moonlight, Chen Nian's face remained pale, but in those eyes, there was no longer despair and fear, but a renewed glimmer of light belonging to a young girl. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul murmured in the Mental Sea: 'You won this round. But the Heavenly Eye will not let this go... It has already sensed the Heavenly Fate Lock Key leaving the imperial city. What you will face next is something far more terrifying than the imperial dynasty's pursuit.' Chen Jislightly颔首，心中早已有了计较。皇帝想当天道的主人，天道之眼要利用皇帝——而他陈机，要做的从来只有一件事。defy fate，护住想护的人。

dialogue.content: (Suddenly gripping his robe tightly) Brother, there's something else... In the forbidden land, I could always hear a voice, an existence not belonging to this world. It kept calling your name, saying something... 'Heavenly Secrets return to their position'. Brother, what exactly is that?

text.content: Chen Ji's脚步一顿。Heavenly Secrets return to their position... these four words were like a thunderclap, splitting open the hazy fog in his heart. He thought of the voice at the end of the previous chapter—an existence utterly different from the Heavenly Eye, calling his true name. That was not Chen Nian. That was... Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul沉默了许久，终于开口：'Chen Ji, some things... it's time to tell you part of the truth. The Tianji Record is not the creation of the Heavenly Eye, but rather...' Before the words finished, the direction of the imperial city suddenly传来一声惊天动地的咆哮——那是天道意志显化的征兆，带着毁天灭地的furious。Mo Xiansheng's remnant soulsuddenly惊呼：'不好！It追来了！'

Chen Ji's眼神瞬间凌厉如刀。他将陈念护在身后，掌心的天机之力急速凝聚。远处的夜空中，一只巨大的金色眼眸正在slowly睁开，漠然俯瞰着这片大地。Those金眼显露出赤裸裸的意志投影——不再隐藏，展现其存在。Chen Nian的身体剧烈颤抖，她体内的龙脉之灵仿佛感应到某种召唤，crazedstruggling。'Brother... it wants to pull me back...' Chen Nian的脸惨白如纸，额上冷汗涔涔。Chen机一把扶住她，声音steady如山：'别怕。有哥哥在，谁也带不走你。'他抬起头，直视那只高高在上的金色眼眸，嘴角勾起一抹讥诮的弧度。

dialogue.content: (Staring directly at the Heavenly Eye) Want to touch my sister? Go ahead and try.

text.content: 那只金色眼眸slightly眯起，一股无形的imposing如潮水般向Chen机倾轧而来。这是天道意志的碾压——寻常cultivator恐怕难以承受。然而Chen机如悬崖上的青松，巍然不动。天机录残页在识海中crazed闪烁，Mo Xiansheng's remnant soulurgent道：'不可力敌！Your cultivation is far from able to confront heavenly will directly! Go—use the spacetime power of Tianji Record, take her out of this dimension!' Chen机没有hesitated，掌心的时空之力瞬间炸开，一道巨大的裂隙凭空浮现。
Chen机一把揽住Chen念的腰，纵身跃入裂隙之中。身后，那只金色眼眸射出一道璀璨光芒，试图吞噬他们——但已经晚了。时空裂隙轰然闭合，将毁灭性力量隔绝在另一维度。Chen机再次睁开眼时，面前是一片陌生的山川。明月高悬，繁星点点，空气中弥漫着淡淡的花香。Chen念蜷缩在他怀中，已因脱力而昏睡过去，苍白的脸上终于有了一丝安宁的神色。Chen机低头看着妹妹，嘴角slightly上扬。

Safe. For now, temporarily safe. He gently placed Chen念 on a flat stone, taking a robe from his Qiankun bag to cushion her. Tianji Record fragments floated beside him, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul finally exhaled: 'This ordeal is over. But Chen机, the Heavenly Eye has locked onto your aura. Next time, it won't be just a projection. You must quickly gather more fragments and enhance your strength... otherwise, next time, you might not escape so easily.' Chen机没有回答，只是静静看着熟睡中的Chen念，目光gentle得不像话。Seventeen years. He finally found her.

夜风轻拂，带来远山深处隐约的狼嚎。Chen机的目光扫过四周，确认暂时没有追兵后，才终于放下紧绷的心弦。他轻轻在Chen念身旁坐下，手指拂过她的发丝，心中却在飞速盘算。皇帝想用Chen念进行改写天命的仪式，天道之眼想利用皇帝打破三界平衡，而他从始至终都只是各方棋局中一枚struggling求存的棋子。但现在不同了。天命锁钥已经在他手中，Chen念的存在本身就是对天道之眼计划的破坏。只要他足够快，足够强，就能在天道之眼反应过来之前，编织出一张足以反噬它的罗网。

dialogue.content: (Murmuring in dreams) Brother... don't go... Nian Nian will be good...

text.content: Chen机的动作一顿，心中某处柔软的角落被狠狠击中。他伸出手，将Chen念的手握在掌心，轻声道：'哥哥不走。哥哥哪儿也不去。' Chen念在梦中似乎听到了这句话，眉眼间的panicked渐渐舒展，嘴角甚至浮起一丝浅浅的笑意。Chen机就这样静静地守着她，一夜未眠。Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul在识海中幽幽sighing：'你变了，Chen机。以前那个算无遗策、ruthlessdetermined的你...现在却会为了一个女孩彻夜守候。' Chen机没有回答，只是在心中默默说了一句——那是因为，在成为棋手之前，他首先是一个哥哥。
